messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - model-quality-regression detected for tenant AcmeFin in dedicated pool us-west-2-dedicated-3. Alert rule: `quality_drop_vQA > 12%` over 15m. Impact: single-tenant, production traffic seeing increased hallucinations and missing entities. Pager sent to #incidents and oncall.

sara_oncall: I'm on it. Pulling logs and eval diffs now. Any idea when the quant profile rolled? :mag_right:

miguel_sre: I see a deploy event at 2024-07-05T02:11:03Z for `quant-profile-opt-v2` targeted at AcmeFin's pool. CPU/GPU metrics look normal, but token-level perplexity spiked for requests routed to that tenant. Looks like a bad quantization/precision change.

anya_ml: Confirming. Our QA eval suite shows BLEU/ROUGE drops and an increase in hallucination rate for prompts that exercise financial entity extraction. Likely numeric stability issues after 4-bit quant changes. Repro locally on same model+profile.

sara_oncall: Customer impact: jess_cs, can you confirm how many customers affected? It's single-tenant but want exact severity wording for comms.

jess_cs: AcmeFin only. They reported anomalies at 02:20 UTC. They're in production with heavy transaction summaries. They're concerned about regulatory wording errors. I've opened internal ticket FIN-5123 and updated AcmeFin support with a short note: "We are investigating; mitigation in progress". They'll escalate to legal if not mitigated quickly.

ryan_am: Heads up: AcmeFin is on an enterprise contract with dedicated SLA. We need to prioritize a revert and a rollback plan + postmortem. Also coordinate a clear customer timeline.

sara_oncall: Agreed. Proposed immediate mitigation: revert quant-profile to previous stable `quant-profile-opt-v1` for tenant only (no global rollback). Anya, can you prepare the revert artifact and a canary before full flip?

anya_ml: Will do. I can build the v1 artifact and run a quick smoke canary against a snapshot of their prompts. Estimated 12-15 minutes to produce and validate.

miguel_sre: On infra side, I can isolate traffic routing for AcmeFin to a fallback routing pool and pin them to the previous model version once you give the artifact. Steps:

1) Drain queue to prevent long in-flight KV cache states: `rdwctl drain --tenant AcmeFin --grace 30s`
2) Apply routing override: `rdwctl route set --tenant AcmeFin --model redwood/llama-quant --version v1 --pool us-west-2-fallback`
3) Confirm instances spin up and healthchecks pass: `rdwctl health --tenant AcmeFin`

I'll be ready to run once Anya signals.

incident-bot: oncall-change: sara_oncall is acknowledged as owner (@sara_oncall). Handoff to next oncall scheduled at 1712351400.

sara_oncall: Running the steps now. Miguel, prepping infra. Anya, ping here when v1 artifact is uploaded to artifact registry.

anya_ml: Artifact uploaded: `s3://redwood-artifacts/quant/llama-quant-v1-acmefin-1712349876.tar.gz`. Smoke tests: 6/6 financial prompts matched baseline, hallucination rate dropped back to expected. Ready for revert. :white_check_mark:

miguel_sre: Executing drain and route change.

miguel_sre: `rdwctl drain --tenant AcmeFin --grace 30s` -> ok
miguel_sre: `rdwctl route set --tenant AcmeFin --model redwood/llama-quant --version v1 --pool us-west-2-fallback` -> ok, 3 instances allocated
miguel_sre: `rdwctl health --tenant AcmeFin` -> all green

sara_oncall: Observability: monitoring token quality metrics, api error rates, latency. Initial traffic shows immediate drop in hallucination signals. Clients starting to report improvements.

jess_cs: Just got note from AcmeFin: they see improvement in generated summaries. They've paused internal alerts but want confirmation when fully stable. I'll give them ETA ~30min and request they keep a sample set flowing.

anya_ml: I'll keep an eye on the batch evals and run a longer regression test. If anything else pops, I'll revert again and escalate.

ryan_am: Great work. Please prepare a short summary for the customer describing root cause (quant profile regression) and steps taken (tenant-specific revert, canary, smoke tests). Legal wants logs retained.

sara_oncall: Action items captured:
- miguel_sre: keep routing override for 2 hours and monitor (done)
- anya_ml: run extended regression tests and upload results to FIN-5123 (in progress)
- jess_cs: update customer at +30m and close loop when fully stable (in progress)
- sara_oncall: file incident postmortem and assign follow-ups (will do)

incident-bot: incident-status: P1 mitigated -> monitoring. Owner: sara_oncall. Start: 1712349876. Mitigated at 1712351345.

sara_oncall: Marking thread as resolved for active mitigation. Will keep it open for postmortem notes. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

jess_cs: Thanks team, customer is happy for now. I'll log their feedback in FIN-5123.

anya_ml: I'll include quant traces and numerical stability notes in the postmortem.

miguel_sre: Leaving routing override until 1712358000 as precaution, will then revert routing to default if metrics stable.

sara_oncall: Closing live coordination. Postmortem owners: sara_oncall (ops), anya_ml (ml), miguel_sre (infra), jess_cs (customer). ETA for postmortem initial draft: 48h.
